headline: Oil prices jump 7% after Trump says U.S. will hit Iran hard
detail: Geopolitical tensions are escalating, driving oil prices up. This typically leads to a risk-off environment, which could negatively impact your tech-heavy portfolio, especially given your margin use.
rec: Consider trimming some of your tech/chip exposure (e.g., QQQ, SMH) to reduce overall portfolio risk in this environment. Alternatively, consider the SQQQ hedge from your scanner (entry 48.13-48.05, stop 47.71).
